`encrypted.pdf` is a synthetic one-page blank PDF created for this repository with pypdf, encrypted with `fixture-password`. It contains no external document content. To regenerate it:

```python
from pypdf import PdfWriter
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_blank_page(width=300, height=300)
writer.encrypt("fixture-password")
writer.write("tests/fixtures/encrypted.pdf")
```

Other PDF fixtures are generated by `tests/pdf-fixture.ts` during the tests.
